name: whatsapp-connector
description: Private, confirmation-gated WhatsApp text and media access through a self-hosted MCP connector.

interface.shortDescription: Read WhatsApp and send text or media after confirmation
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to a private self-hosted WhatsApp MCP service for scoped chat search, message reading, media retrieval, drafting, and explicit two-step text or media sending.
interface.defaultPrompt: Search or summarize only the WhatsApp messages needed for my request. Draft without sending unless I explicitly ask to send, and always show the exact recipient and frozen text or media metadata before the separate confirmed send step.
